doc.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022

title: Thanks and goodbye
summary: Rowe and Ries thank each other and close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: A tradition of that with jazz ambassadors. So thank you for today and for last night. And congratulations on your career so far and whatever you’re going to do next.

Oh and you are so kind, Monk, for having — and congratulations all the years you’ve been doing this, like you’ve captured a pretty impressive array — I looked at your list I’m like these are all my heroes and favorite musicians. So —
It’s been a rather good gig I’ll say that.
Thank you for doing this, it’s really amazing.
